out.explanation: Statement A on page 369 classifies total secured loans as the sum of fund-based and non-fund-based borrowings (499.48 million), whereas Statement B on page 364 lists fund-based, non-fund-based, and unsecured loans separately before aggregating them to 509.67 million. These figures reflect a difference in categorization and scope of what is included under secured versus total borrowings rather than an inconsistency in the underlying data.
